name: v3_largegain_lemmas_small_mu_supplement
scope: One computed cycle; supplementary, retained with its unresolved comparison.
note: Author script at mu = 0.02, k = 1000 (lambda = 50000, T about 3.26e6).  The comparison "C: M+ < k T-" is equivalent to the positivity of the integral of x over the negative lobe, which is of order k/p_k; M+ and k T- are of order 3e9 and M+ is obtained by trapezoid quadrature on 400001 nodes, whose relative error (measured by the mass-identity comparison of the same run, about 7e-12) exceeds the relative gap of the two sides.  The comparison is below the resolution of the script; it is reported as failed, not relabelled.  The referee integrator covers this parameter pair in v3_largegain_lemmas (group A).
